signatures.head: theorem kanQuillen_model_exists : ∃ m : ModelCategory SSet.{u}, @cofibrations SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithCofibrations = MorphismProperty.monomorphisms SSet.{u} ∧ @fibrations SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithFibrations = SSet.modelCategoryQuillen.J.{u}.rlp ∧ @weakEquivalences SSet.{u} _ m.categoryWithWeakEquivalences = SimplicialModelInputs.geometricWeakEquivalences.{u}
noncomputable def kanQuillenModel : ModelCategory SSet.{u} := Classical.choose kanQuillen_model_exists

def relativeFunctorUncurryHom {A E B : SSet.{u}} (p : E ⟶ B) (a : A ⟶ B) (L : SSet.{u}) : (ihom L).obj (relativeFunctorSpace p a) ⟶ relativeFunctorSpace p (fst A L ≫ a) := relativeFunctorCurry ((α_ A L ((ihom L).obj (relativeFunctorSpace p a))).hom ≫ relativeFunctorUncurry (uncurry (𝟙 ((ihom L).obj (relativeFunctorSpace p a))))) (by rw [Category.assoc, relativeFunctorUncurry_projection] simp only [associator_hom_fst_assoc])
def relativeFunctorExponentialIso {A E B : SSet.{u}} (p : E ⟶ B) (a : A ⟶ B) (L : SSet.{u}) : relativeFunctorSpace p (fst A L ≫ a) ≅ (ihom L).obj (relativeFunctorSpace p a) where
def rightStraighteningInfinityMap (B : SSet.{u}) : RightFibrationInfinity B ⟶ PresheafInfinity B := rightFibrationOppositeInfinityMap B ≫ leftStraighteningInfinityMap B.op

lemma rightStraighteningInfinityMap_isFullyFaithful (B : SSet.{u}) [Quasicategory B] : IsFullyFaithful (rightStraighteningInfinityMap B) := (rightFibrationOppositeInfinityMap_isQCatEquivalence B).isFullyFaithful.comp (leftStraighteningInfinityMap_isFullyFaithful B.op)

3.2.4.1.decision: generic model の derived comparison は存在するが、原典の marked Stφ+/Unφ+ と具体的な source/target ModelCategory instance がない。既に同値と仮定した simplicial functor の nerve equivalence は、この Quillen iff を証明しない。
